description: Customer-facing pages: cart, checkout, orders & tracking, wishlist. Depends on FEAT-001 (types, contexts, CSS classes all in place). These four pages share the same localStorage-based data flow and can be built together as one coherent feature.
steps: 1. Create app/(site)/cart/page.tsx: server component (no 'use client'), metadata title 'Your cart', renders <CartView />.

2. Create components/views/CartView.tsx ('use client'): reads items/totalCount/removeItem/updateQty/clearCart from useCart(). Empty state (when items.length === 0): with heading 'Your cart is empty' and ButtonLink to /marketplace. Non-empty state:
with left column (list of .oi-cart-item rows) and right column (.oi-cart-summary). Each cart item row: art thumbnail (span with class oi-cart-item__art oi-top-product__art--{product.art} showing product.glyph emoji), product name, seller, unit price, quantity stepper (.oi-stepper with − button calling updateQty(slug, qty-1), qty display, + button calling updateQty(slug, qty+1), min qty 1), line total (priceValue * quantity formatted as ₦X,XXX), remove button (Icon close size 16, calls removeItem). Order summary aside: subtotal (sum priceValue*qty), 'Delivery calculated at checkout' note in muted, horizontal rule, total, ButtonLink to /checkout variant='gold' block. Breadcrumbs: Home → Cart.
3. Create app/(site)/checkout/page.tsx: server component, title 'Checkout', renders <CheckoutView />.

4. Create components/views/CheckoutView.tsx ('use client'): 3-step wizard. State: step (1|2|3), deliveryInfo (DeliveryInfo), paymentMethod (PaymentMethod). Render .oi-checkout-steps bar at top showing 3 steps (Delivery, Payment, Review) with is-active/is-done classes. Step 1 – Delivery form: fields name, phone, address (textarea rows=3), state (select with NIGERIAN_STATES array — define inline as const NIGERIAN_STATES = ['Abia','Adamawa','Akwa Ibom','Anambra','Bauchi','Bayelsa','Benue','Borno','Cross River','Delta','Ebonyi','Edo','Ekiti','Enugu','FCT (Abuja)','Gombe','Imo','Jigawa','Kaduna','Kano','Katsina','Kebbi','Kogi','Kwara','Lagos','Nasarawa','Niger','Ogun','Ondo','Osun','Oyo','Plateau','Rivers','Sokoto','Taraba','Yobe','Zamfara']), notes textarea optional. Continue button validates required fields (name, phone, address, state non-empty) before advancing. Step 2 – Payment: three .oi-payment-option radio cards: 'Pay by Card' (Icon lock), 'Bank Transfer' (Icon wallet), 'Pay on Delivery' (Icon package). Selecting a card sets paymentMethod and adds is-selected class. Continue button advances. Step 3 – Review: read-only summary of delivery address + payment method + items list from useCart(). Total. 'Place Order' button: generates id = 'OL-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(), builds CustomerOrder, reads existing orders from localStorage 'oilinga_orders' (try/catch, default []), appends new order, writes back, calls clearCart(), calls router.push('/orders/' + id).
5. Create app/(site)/orders/page.tsx: server component, title 'Your orders', renders <OrdersView />.

6. Create components/views/OrdersView.tsx ('use client'): on mount reads localStorage 'oilinga_orders' (SSR guard, try/catch, default []). Empty state: + 'No orders yet' + ButtonLink to /marketplace. Non-empty: Breadcrumbs (Home → Orders), page heading 'Your orders', .oi-orders-list with each order as .oi-order-row card: left column (order ID as Link to /orders/[id], date formatted with toLocaleDateString, items summary: `${order.items[0].product.name}${order.items.length > 1 ? ` + ${order.items.length - 1} more` : ''}`), right column (total formatted, Badge with status tone: Processing→'pending', Shipped→'shipped', Delivered→'delivered').

7. Create app/(site)/orders/[id]/page.tsx: server component (cannot read localStorage at build — must be client or use generateStaticParams workaround). Decision: make it a thin server page that renders a client component <OrderDetailView params={params} />. Title 'Order details'. Note: since data is localStorage-only, generateStaticParams is not possible. Export export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' to prevent static generation errors.

8. Create components/views/OrderDetailView.tsx ('use client'): receives orderId prop (string). On mount reads localStorage 'oilinga_orders', finds order by id. If not found: 'Order not found' message + Link to /orders. If found: Breadcrumbs (Home → Orders → id), order header (.oi-dashboard__top pattern: order ID, date, status badge), 4-step .oi-order-timeline: steps ['Order placed', 'Processing', 'Shipped', 'Delivered']. Status logic: 'Processing' = steps 0+1 done; 'Shipped' = 0+1+2 done; 'Delivered' = all done. Each step shows .oi-timeline-step with is-done (past) or is-active (current) or default (future). Below timeline: .oi-order-detail-grid with left column (items table: .oi-table with product name, qty, unit price, line total) and right column (delivery address card: name, phone, address, state, notes). Below grid: 'Need help?' link to mailto:support@oilinga.com. If order.status === 'Delivered': show ButtonLink to /account/reviews?product=[first item slug] variant='outline' 'Write a review'.
9. Create app/(site)/wishlist/page.tsx: server component, title 'Your wishlist', renders <WishlistView />.

10. Create components/views/WishlistView.tsx ('use client'): reads items from useWishlist(). Empty state: + 'Your wishlist is empty' + ButtonLink to /marketplace. Non-empty: Breadcrumbs (Home → Wishlist), page heading, .oi-product-grid. Each item renders a modified ProductCard-like card but with a filled red heart remove button (position absolute, .oi-product-card__wish.is-active) that calls removeFromWishlist(slug) + toast 'Removed from wishlist'.

11. Modify components/marketplace/ProductCard.tsx: import useWishlist. Add heart toggle button to card: inside .oi-product-card__art div, add <button type='button' className={cn('oi-product-card__wish', isInWishlist(product.slug) && 'is-active')} onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); toggleWishlist(product); notify(isInWishlist(product.slug) ? 'Removed from wishlist' : 'Added to wishlist'); }} aria-label={isInWishlist(product.slug) ? `Remove ${product.name} from wishlist` : `Add ${product.name} to wishlist`}><Icon name='heart' size={14} /></button>. Note: Icon 'heart' with fill needs CSS: .oi-product-card__wish.is-active svg { fill: currentColor; stroke: currentColor; }. Also fix the add-to-cart button in ProductCard footer to actually call addItem from useCart() instead of just showing a toast (currently it only toasts but doesn't add — check: yes, ProductCard.tsx line 'onClick={() => notify(...)' does NOT call addItem. Fix this: import useCart, call addItem(product) then notify).

12. Modify components/marketplace/AddToCart.tsx: import useWishlist. Change 'Save for later' button to call toggleWishlist(product) and update label/style based on isInWishlist(product.slug): if in wishlist, label 'Saved ♡' with filled icon; otherwise 'Save for later'.
acceptance_criteria: /cart page renders CartView with empty state showing empty-cart.svg illustration
/cart page with items shows line items, qty steppers (calling updateQty), and summary with proceed-to-checkout
/checkout page renders 3-step wizard; step 1 validates required fields; step 3 places order, clears cart, redirects to /orders/[id]
/orders page shows empty state or list of orders read from oilinga_orders localStorage
/orders/[id] page shows order detail with 4-step timeline and correct is-done/is-active states
/wishlist page shows empty state or product grid; heart button removes items
ProductCard heart button toggles wishlist membership with correct aria-label and filled/outline state
ProductCard add-to-cart button calls addItem (not just toast)
yarn build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
verification: cd /Users/mac/Desktop/oilinga && yarn build — must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors
findings: All four customer-facing pages are implemented. Key details for FEAT-003: (1) oilinga_orders localStorage key is written at checkout with CustomerOrder[] — use the same key in any admin/seller order view. (2) /orders/[id] uses export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' and an async params prop (Next.js 16 pattern). (3) ProductCard.tsx now calls addItem() on add-to-cart and toggleWishlist() on the heart button. (4) AddToCart.tsx 'Save for later' now wires to toggleWishlist with is-active state and 'Saved ♡' label. (5) No new npm packages added. (6) CSS classes .oi-btn-icon, .oi-muted, .oi-page, .oi-page-title, .oi-section-title, .oi-form-error, .oi-link are used inline — they should already exist from Phase 1/2 base CSS; if FEAT-003 adds reviews it can reuse .oi-review-form / .oi-star-picker / .oi-review-card classes added in FEAT-001 Phase 3 CSS block.
